Xiao Hua is in the kitchen preparing dinner when suddenly he hears the doorbell ring. He turns down the fire and goes to open the door, finding it is his friend Xiao Li. Xiao Li holds some movie tickets in his hand and invites Xiao Hua to watch a movie. Xiao Hua thinks for a moment and tells Xiao Li that he must finish dinner first. At this time, Xiao Hua's sister also runs over and says she can help cook, letting Xiao Hua go play. Xiao Hua looks at the half-cooked dinner in the kitchen and hesitates.

[Question]
What does Xiao Hua do next after hearing Xiao Li's invitation?

[Candidate Answers]
A. He continues to cook dinner.
B. He goes to discuss with other friends whether to go to the movies.
C. He accepts Xiao Li's invitation and goes to watch a movie.
D. He lets his sister finish dinner and he rests.
